content.text: Edit @Video 1 into a coherent cinematic live-action-style fan scene. Use the reference video's visible performance, positions, support, object possession, camera direction and timing as semantic guidance, not as a guarantee of identical frames. Replace only the blond, nape-tied girl riding beside the glasses-wearing lead with Carina Malfoy, an approximately fifteen-year-old Slytherin student: fair skin, youthful narrow face, pale platinum hair tied at the nape, a cute, pretty appearance and a small proud smile. Replace the coarse dark-haired boy with Harry Potter, an approximately fifteen-year-old Gryffindor student: youthful face, tousled black hair, round dark glasses and a small forehead scar. Keep their white collars, grey V-neck knitwear, black school robes and black school shoes; Carina has a green-and-silver tie and green robe lining, Harry a red-and-gold tie and red lining. Their lower robe panels stay secured at the waist for safe riding. Carina's pleated skirt retains an opaque riding underlayer; Harry wears charcoal trousers. Keep the same two lead identities throughout. Twelve anonymous school players, including short pale-haired field players, retain their own identities and coarse silhouettes on their own brooms where visible. Keep their faces distinct from both leads. Keep a sunlit pale-blue sky, open green lawn, simple pale hoop goals and sparse surroundings, with consistent soft daylight. Do not add spectators, buildings, rescue equipment, a wand rescue, a kiss or a victory. Preserve one uncaught gold winged Snitch, one red Quaffle, two dark Bludgers, fourteen brooms, four Beater bats and six hoop goals; never duplicate a consequential object. Over this12-second segment, show Harry's overreaching left arm and loss of thigh support, then his right hand holding his own broom from below. He swings with it, searches with his feet, attempts unsuccessfully to regain the shaft with his free arm, and his supporting grip creeps along the wood. His broom keeps gliding; he does not freely fall while that grip remains. Bring the gold Snitch within a handspan of Carina's open left hand while Harry remains lower, ahead and to her right in the same coherent space. Make her attention turn from the prize to Harry. She withdraws the open hand and closes it on her own steering shaft, choosing his safety. End at the beginning of her descent; the Snitch stays unheld. Preserve the height above visible grass and the distant field players. No spoken line belongs to this segment.
